Privacy Choices & Policy

Privacy Policy & Choices

Studio Privacy Notice • CCPA / CPRA Compliant
Analytics & Telemetry

Notice for California Residents (CCPA / CPRA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) to know what personal information is collected, and to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal data, including third-party analytics and performance cookies.

How Information Is Used

Maude’s Games does not sell your personal data for monetary value. We use privacy-compliant telemetry and analytics tools (such as aggregate page metrics and game interaction analytics) to ensure gameplay stability, diagnose crashes, and refine future titles.

Exercising Your Opt-Out Rights

Clicking "Opt Out (Do Not Sell/Share)" will immediately disable non-essential analytics tracking scripts for your browser session. You may update your preference at any time from this window or the website footer.

Cube Fall — Version 2 • Effective September 16, 2026

Cube Fall — Privacy Policy

Welcome to Cube Fall ("the Game"), developed and published by Maude's Games.

Cube Fall is a fast-paced platform survival game in which players control a cube while the game environment continuously moves upward. Players must move left and right, jump between platforms, avoid falling, escape dangerous spikes, navigate moving and breakable platforms, and survive for as long as possible.

This Privacy Policy explains how Maude's Games collects, uses, discloses, stores, and protects information associated with your download, installation, testing, and use of Cube Fall. At Maude's Games, we respect player privacy and believe that games should collect only the information reasonably necessary to operate, maintain, support, secure, and improve the player experience.

By downloading, installing, testing, or using Cube Fall, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

1. Developer Information

Developer/Publisher: Maude’s Games
Contact Person: Natasha Maude Wafula
Support Email: info@seekemhub.com
Business Address: 260 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660, United States

2. Account Registration

Cube Fall does not require players to create an account, profile, username, password, or membership in order to play the current version of the Game. Maude's Games does not intentionally require players to provide: full legal name, mailing address, telephone number, date of birth, government identification, financial information, precise location, contact lists, photos, biometric information, or social media credentials to access normal gameplay.

3. Information You Voluntarily Provide

You may voluntarily provide information if you contact Maude's Games for technical support, bug reporting, gameplay problems, testing feedback, compatibility problems, feature suggestions, general questions, or privacy requests. Information submitted through support communications is used primarily to investigate and respond to your request.

4. Game Technology & Engine

Cube Fall is built using standard mobile development frameworks. Any engine-provided or SDK-provided service that independently collects player information will be identified and updated to reflect the actual technical stack before or promptly after each release.

5. Technical and Diagnostic Information

Depending on your device, Android operating system, Google Play services, application configuration, and technical requirements of the Game, certain technical information may be generated or processed automatically (device model, OS version, resolution, crash/error logs, performance diagnostics). This is used solely to identify crashes, diagnose bugs, improve compatibility, and maintain application stability.

6. Gameplay Information

Cube Fall saves gameplay-related information locally on your device so the Game can function properly and preserve appropriate player preferences (current score, highest score, survival progress, audio/control settings). Stored gameplay information is not intentionally transmitted to Maude's Games servers unless an explicit online cloud save feature is introduced in a future update.

7. How We Use Information

Information associated with Cube Fall is used to operate, maintain, and provide gameplay functionality; save local preferences; diagnose crashes and investigate software bugs; improve performance and controls; respond to support requests; and comply with legal obligations. Maude's Games does not sell, rent, or trade personal information provided through Cube Fall.

8. Advertising

The current version of Cube Fall is not intended to collect personal information for behavioral advertising by Maude's Games.

9. Analytics

Cube Fall is designed so players can enjoy the Game without creating an account. Any future analytics integration will be limited to gameplay stability and performance metrics.

10. Third-Party Platforms and Services

Cube Fall is distributed through Google Play. Google and platform providers may process technical or account-related data under their own independent terms and policies.

11. Payments and In-App Purchases

The current version does not collect direct payment information. Any future in-app purchases will be processed securely through official platform stores (e.g., Google Play).

12. Children's Privacy (COPPA)

Cube Fall is designed as a casual entertainment game and does not require personal information to play. Maude's Games does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or applicable age in your jurisdiction) in accordance with COPPA. Parents may contact info@seekemhub.com with inquiries.

13. Data Sharing and Disclosure

Maude's Games does not sell or rent personal information associated with Cube Fall. Information is disclosed only when required for support, legal compliance, or security protection.

14. Data Retention & Security

Gameplay data stored locally on your device remains until you clear app data, reset the game, or uninstall. Maude's Games implements reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect all user data.

15. International Users & GDPR

Where GDPR or UK GDPR applies, data is processed on the basis of legitimate interests (responding to support, maintaining game integrity). Users may request data access, correction, or deletion via info@seekemhub.com.

16. California Privacy Notice (CCPA / CPRA)

California residents have rights under CCPA/CPRA to know, delete, and opt out of data sharing. Maude's Games does not sell or share personal information collected through Cube Fall for cross-context behavioral advertising.

17. Governing Law & Contact

This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the State of California. Questions or requests can be directed to: Natasha Maude Wafula, Maude's Games, 260 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660, USA. Email: info@seekemhub.com.

Sky Runner — Version 2 • Effective September 16, 2026

Sky Runner — Privacy Policy

Welcome to Sky Runner ("the Game"), developed and published by Maude's Games.

Sky Runner is a fast-paced Unity-based flying game in which players control a plane and navigate through the sky while avoiding hills, spikes, and other dangerous obstacles. The objective is to continue flying for as long as possible, avoid collisions, and achieve the highest score possible.

This Privacy Policy explains how Maude's Games collects, uses, discloses, stores, and protects information associated with your download, installation, testing, and use of Sky Runner. Maude's Games is committed to collecting only information reasonably necessary to operate, support, secure, maintain, and improve the Game.

By downloading, installing, testing, or using Sky Runner, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

1. Developer Information

Developer/Publisher: Maude’s Games
Contact Person: Natasha Maude Wafula
Support Email: info@seekemhub.com
Business Address: 260 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660, United States

2. Account Registration

The current version of Sky Runner does not require a player to create a Maude's Games account in order to play. Players are not intentionally required to provide full legal name, username, password, mailing address, telephone number, date of birth, financial information, precise location, contact lists, biometric information, or social media login for normal gameplay.

3. Information You Voluntarily Provide

If you contact Maude's Games directly for assistance or feedback, information provided (name, email, device model, Android OS version, game version, bug description, screenshots) is used primarily to respond to you, resolve technical issues, and improve the Game.

4. Technical and Diagnostic Information

Depending on your device, Android OS, and Google Play environment, limited technical information (device manufacturer, OS version, application version, resolution, crash reports, performance diagnostics) may be processed to identify software defects, improve frame-rate stability, and maintain application security.

5. Gameplay and Score Information

Sky Runner stores limited gameplay information locally on your device (current score, highest score, sound/control preferences). Information necessary to display or preserve your score is stored locally on your device and not transmitted to external servers unless an online cloud feature is added.

6. Unity Engine Technology

Sky Runner is developed using the Unity game-development platform. The Unity engine provides underlying technology used to render graphics, process gameplay physics, manage scenes, and handle controls.

7. How We Use Information

Information associated with Sky Runner is used to operate the Game, provide gameplay functionality, maintain stability, save local preferences, diagnose crashes, and improve responsiveness. Maude's Games does not sell, rent, or trade personal information provided directly through Sky Runner.

8. Advertising & Analytics

The current version is not intended to collect personal information for behavioral advertising. Any future analytics or ad networks will be strictly disclosed and compliant with Google Play Data Safety standards.

9. Children's Privacy (COPPA)

Sky Runner is a casual entertainment game and does not require personal information to access gameplay. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 in compliance with COPPA. Inquiries may be directed to info@seekemhub.com.

10. International Users & GDPR

Where GDPR or UK GDPR applies, data is processed on the basis of legitimate interests (support and game maintenance). Users can request data access or erasure at info@seekemhub.com.

11. California Privacy Notice (CCPA / CPRA)

California residents have rights under CCPA/CPRA to know, delete, correct, and opt out of data sharing. Maude's Games does not sell or share personal information collected directly through Sky Runner for cross-context behavioral advertising.

12. Governing Law & Contact

Governed by the laws of the State of California. Inquiries: Natasha Maude Wafula, Maude's Games, 260 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660, USA. Email: info@seekemhub.com.
